priorityList: Use Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury and maintain Ragefire damage.
Use Reaver's Glaive to apply Reaver's Mark whenever you do not have the Rending Strike or Glaive Flurry buffs active.
Use Death Sweep (or Blade Dance) as your highest priority spender in AoE, especially if the Glaive Flurry buff is active.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to enter Demonic form and generate Fury, ideally when Blade Dance is on cooldown.
Use Essence Break while in Metamorphosis or Demonic form, immediately followed by Death Sweep and Annihilation.
Use Metamorphosis to reset the cooldowns of Eye Beam and Blade Dance, or when your current Metamorphosis/Demonic buff is about to expire.
Trigger Inertia or Initiative using Vengeful Retreat before major damage windows like Eye Beam or high-priority Blade Dances.
Use Annihilation (or Chaos Strike) as a secondary spender to consume Rending Strike buffs or when Blade Dance is unavailable.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown as a major damage source, ensuring Essence Break is not currently active to avoid clipping.
Use Fel Rush to consume Inertia Trigger procs for increased damage during your burst windows.
Use Felblade to generate Fury if you fall below 40 or to stay in melee range of your targets.
Pick up Soul Fragments manually if your Fury is below 40 to prevent resource starving.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler if you have the Soulscar talent and no other high-priority abilities are available.
Cast Arcane Torrent if you are low on Fury and need a small boost to continue your rotation.
Prioritize targets with Reaver's Mark when using Annihilation or Chaos Strike to maximize the Hero Talent benefits.
